name: Ineffable Coffee
description: Spanish specialty coffee roaster with an online store on Shopify. Sells coffee beans, cold brew, brewing gear, books and merchandising. Its shipping page states delivery to the Peninsula, the Balearic Islands and Portugal and no shipping to the Canary Islands, Ceuta, Melilla or Gibraltar.
description_es: Tostador español de café de especialidad con tienda online en Shopify. Vende café en grano, cold brew, accesorios de preparación, libros y merchandising. Su página de envíos indica entrega en Península, Baleares y Portugal y que no envía a Canarias, Ceuta, Melilla ni Gibraltar.
